style: 2D hand-drawn cartoon illustration in a children's picture-book style, clean brown outlines, flat colors with soft cel shading, large expressive eyes, like a printed storybook page. Not 3D, not a render, not a photo.
sheet: Full body, standing, front view, on a plain white background. No words or letters.
rules: Describe hair and clothes only. Never describe skin color or ethnicity (Daniel, 2026-10-01). People keep the printed picture-book look.

characters.name: pip
characters.description: Pip, a small brown puppy with a cream chest, floppy ears, big shiny eyes, and a red collar with a small gold tag. He sits and smiles.
characters.look: Pip, a small brown puppy with a cream chest, floppy ears, big shiny eyes, and a red collar with a small gold tag.

characters.name: squeaky

characters.name: mia
